details: Animation uses d3.timer (RAF-backed) for projection morphing with a transitioning flag guard that correctly blocks concurrent transitions; pointer events API unifies mouse/touch cleanly. Minor: per-frame construction of a new d3.geoProjection closure inside the timer is expensive (~200 country path recalculations at 60fps) but is intrinsic to the morphing technique, not an un-throttled brush/zoom handler.
